profile.headline: Software Engineer at Elevate
profile.summary: Working mainly with Ruby on Rails and the MEAN stack. Also have experience with React/Redux and Svelte.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the migration of the front-end application to Sapper to add the benefits of SSR, code-splitting, and routing while maintaining the instantaneous navigation feel of a single-page app.
- Built various reactive front-end components in Svelte, including data visualizations of user action logs.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
- Streamlined the collaboration between internal and contracted engineering teams.
- Prioritized improvements of the seller central UI through analysis of user data, attributing to a +20% growth in the rate of number of products listed over a quarter.

company.name: North Carolina Joint Underwriting Association and North Carolina Insurance Underwriting Association

honors.title: Graduation with Distinction
honors.description: Conducted an original research project examining racial differences in self-presentation with a particular emphasis on the Asian-American population. Completed an honors thesis in the form of an empirical research article and its defense in front of a faculty committee.

projects.title: Animated Image Histogram
projects.description:
A fun, interactive program to turn any image into an image histogram

- Canvas API and JavaScript for pixel by pixel manipulation: Built the animation using only math in JavaScript and canvas API with no libraries.
- Responsive web and mobile design with CSS media queries: Designed an intuitive interface that allows users to adjust various parameters to customize their animations and to capture stills and videos.

projects.title: Museic
projects.description:
A social platform with a unique UI to record and share short melodies

- Created a piano keys UI with React and Tone.js that allows for user input to be saved directly into the database as an array of music notes, eliminating the need for audio file storage.
- Built a real-time visualization component to draw user input notes to the DOM (using only math and CSS), enhancing user engagement and interactivity.
- Secured user auth by encrypting user credentials using the JSON Web Token (JWT) library.
- Facilitated collaboration by managing Git workflow, and demonstrated the ability to work on others’ code.
